correctness.rationale: For N>=3, E={0,1,2}, B any unordered frequency triple in Z_N, column-wise unitary phase changes make V_B*V_B real symmetric diagonal 3 with offdiagonal g(d)=1+2cos(2pi*d/N); Vandermonde determinant is nonzero for three distinct roots. For 3|N the orthogonal balanced sets give rho=1, equality forces vanishing all cross terms. For N mod3=1,2, the balanced g-values (a,a,b) or (b,b,a) yield stated three eigenvalues. For any min gap r<q, strict g(q-1)>a+|b| and principal-submatrix interlacing yield rho strictly above balanced Gershgorin bound; the only remaining unbalanced type for mod3=2 is (q,q,q+2). The exact half-angle polynomial identity a(t-a)-b^2=-4v^2(v-sqrt3)^2 P(v)/(1+v^2)^6, v=tan(pi/(3N)), gives positivity via P(v)<0 for 0<v<1/10 at N>=11. Independently verified all three symbolic trigonometric identities with SymPy; enumerated all unordered triples N=3..33 and verified best value, balanced gap necessity and multiplicities. Small N=3,4,5,6,8 handled in source with explicit eigenvalues; N=7,9,10 handled by previous cases. This verifies infinitely many N analytically rather than extrapolating finite experiments.
